PRESERVING THE PROPERTY RECORD
Register of Deeds staff review, record, index, and preserve documents that affect real property in St. Joseph County. During 2025, the office continued expanding electronic recording, remote access, and the searchable historical index.
Digitized land record images extend back to 1834. Every submission is reviewed before it becomes part of the permanent public record. Incomplete documents are returned for correction.
